effects: Pulls exactly `amount` ETHFI (collateral 0xFe0c…) from the signer into the vault via safeTransferFrom, which spends the signer's ETHFI allowance to the vault.
Mints vault active shares, at a rate set from storage, to `onBehalfOf`, which may be someone other than the signer.
formats.shown: Deposit a given ETHFI amount into the vault, with the share position credited to the named beneficiary.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted to the beneficiary is not shown; it comes from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_);` The descriptor has no shares field because the value is not in the calldata.

effects: Burns the signer's active shares worth `amount` ETHFI, rounded up (previewWithdraw), so the signer's active stake drops by `amount`.
Queues `amount` ETHFI for the next epoch and credits the withdrawal shares to `claimer`, who alone can claim them after that epoch ends.
No tokens move now. The queued amount stays slashable until it is claimed.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of a given ETHFI amount, which the named claim owner can claim later.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned and any later slashing of the queued amount are not shown; both depend on storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake());` In onSlash, `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1] = nextWithdrawals - nextWithdrawalsSlashed;` can reduce what the claimer gets later.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Queues the ETHFI those shares are worth (previewRedeem, from storage) for the next epoch and credits the claim to `claimer`.
No tokens move now. The claim can be made after the next epoch ends.
formats.shown: Queue a raw integer number of vault shares for withdrawal to the named claim owner.

findings.title: redeem: share amount is shown as a raw 18-decimal integer instead of a readable share count.
findings.evidence: ERC4626Math.sol `_decimalsOffset()` returns 0, so shares use the collateral's 18 decimals. The descriptor field `#.shares` has format `raw`. Case 2 shows "Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares", which is about 0.988 shares.
findings.fix: Use format `unit` with params {"base":"shares","decimals":18} and drop "raw" from the label and the interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: redeem: the ETHFI amount queued for the shares is derived from storage and not shown.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed.
Transfers the signer's full withdrawal for that epoch in ETHFI (withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender), from storage) from the vault to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal of a given epoch and send it to the named recipient.

findings.title: claim: the ETHFI amount sent to the recipient comes from storage and is not shown; the intent does not name ETHFI.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _claim: `amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender);` then claim does `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` The intent reads only "Claim withdrawal".
findings.fix: Optionally reword the intent to "Claim ETHFI withdrawal".

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawals for every listed epoch as claimed.
Transfers the sum of those withdrawals in ETHFI (from storage) from the vault to `recipient` in one transfer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals of the listed epochs and send them to the named recipient.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total ETHFI sent to the recipient comes from storage and is not shown.
findings.fix: Optionally reword the intent to "Claim ETHFI withdrawals".
